summary_en: Shin-Etsu Polymer authorized the acquisition of up to 450,000 shares for a maximum of ¥1,250 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 27 to December 31, 2026, representing 0.56% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The shares will be used for stock option exercises.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 26, 2026, Shin-Etsu Polymer's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock based on Article 165(2) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The company will acquire up to 450,000 ordinary shares for a maximum total price of ¥1,250 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 27 to December 31, 2026. This acquisition authorization represents 0.56% of the 80,458,009 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026.

The acquired shares will be held as treasury stock and used for allocating shares upon the exercise of stock option rights. The company did not specify a maximum acquisition price per share in this disclosure. The authorization follows the statutory procedure set out in Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied by Article 165(3).
